title: cluster why --explain model output, v1
description: The only shape a model may return for `cluster why --explain`. Output that does not validate is discarded and the runbook for the code stands alone. Every name, number and reason in `lines` must appear in the envelope the model was given; the grounding test asserts that separately.

code.description: The stall code being explained. Must equal the code the analyzer emitted.

lines.description: Exactly three plain-language lines: what is blocked, why, and what changes when it is fixed. No condition type names, no markdown, no newlines.

next_command.description: One command the user can paste, on one line. A kubectl, cluster, docker or clusterctl invocation.
